title: Leonardo Has an Idea
role: Standalone interlude · Musical comedy · Introduces creator leakage

believed.borges: The Idea is a new thing in the room and should be treated as one.
believed.the-idea: It is not finished being decided.

starting_positions.leonardo: Wants to market Future Radio with his Idea.
starting_positions.borges: Wants to connect the marketing to what is established.
starting_positions.the-idea: Wants to become something real and independently meaningful; its ideas begin speaking in imagined versions of the characters' voices.

trigger: Leonardo and Borges attempt to market Future Radio. Leonardo has an Idea, which turns out to have ideas of its own.
exit_condition: The Idea's own ideas take over part of the direction, or the room recognizes creator leakage.

variations.start: The Idea pitches itself to Borges
The Idea's inner voices disagree about the slogan
The Idea starts correcting how Leonardo describes it
